<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Inspection"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/energy-drink-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Inspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Inspection" name="Begin inspection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Enter_Machine_Type" name="Enter machine type"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Enter_Serial_Number" name="Enter serial number"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Answer_Questions" name="Answer inspection questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Press_Buttons" name="Press buttons"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Collect_Show_Values" name="Collect and show machine values"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Additional_Questions" name="Are additional questions indicated?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Answer_Additional_Questions" name="Answer additional questions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge_Additional_Questions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Inspection" name="Inspection complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Type" sourceRef="Start_Inspection" targetRef="Enter_Machine_Type"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Type_Serial" sourceRef="Enter_Machine_Type" targetRef="Enter_Serial_Number"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Serial_Questions" sourceRef="Enter_Serial_Number" targetRef="Answer_Questions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Questions_Buttons" sourceRef="Answer_Questions" targetRef="Press_Buttons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Buttons_Values" sourceRef="Press_Buttons" targetRef="Collect_Show_Values"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Values_Decision" sourceRef="Collect_Show_Values" targetRef="Gateway_Additional_Questions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_Yes" name="Additional questions indicated" sourceRef="Gateway_Additional_Questions" targetRef="Answer_Additional_Questions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Additional questions are indicated by the inspection results</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_No" name="No additional questions" sourceRef="Gateway_Additional_Questions" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Additional_Questions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_Merge" sourceRef="Answer_Additional_Questions" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Additional_Questions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_End" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge_Additional_Questions" targetRef="End_Inspection"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Inspection"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/energy-drink-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Inspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Inspection">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Inspector" name="Inspector">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Enter_Machine_Type</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Enter_Serial_Number</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Enter_Inspection_Values</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Press_Inspection_Buttons</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Enter_Additional_Values</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Application" name="Inspection application">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Ask_Inspection_Questions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Collect_Machine_Values</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Display_Machine_Values</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Additional_Questions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Ask_Additional_Questions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Merge_Additional_Questions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Inspection" name="Begin inspection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Enter_Machine_Type" name="Enter machine type"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Enter_Serial_Number" name="Enter serial number"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Ask_Inspection_Questions" name="Ask inspection questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Enter_Inspection_Values" name="Enter values for inspection questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Press_Inspection_Buttons" name="Press inspection buttons"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Collect_Machine_Values" name="Automatically collect values from machine"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Display_Machine_Values" name="Show collected values"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Additional_Questions" name="Do the results indicate additional questions?" default="Flow_No_Additional_Questions"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Ask_Additional_Questions" name="Ask additional questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Enter_Additional_Values" name="Enter values for additional questions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge_Additional_Questions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Inspection" name="Inspection complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Type" sourceRef="Start_Inspection" targetRef="Enter_Machine_Type"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Type_Serial" sourceRef="Enter_Machine_Type" targetRef="Enter_Serial_Number"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Serial_Ask" sourceRef="Enter_Serial_Number" targetRef="Ask_Inspection_Questions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ask_Enter" sourceRef="Ask_Inspection_Questions" targetRef="Enter_Inspection_Values"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enter_Press" sourceRef="Enter_Inspection_Values" targetRef="Press_Inspection_Buttons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Press_Collect" sourceRef="Press_Inspection_Buttons" targetRef="Collect_Machine_Values"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Display" sourceRef="Collect_Machine_Values" targetRef="Display_Machine_Values"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Display_Decision" sourceRef="Display_Machine_Values" targetRef="Gateway_Additional_Questions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Additional_Yes" name="Additional questions indicated" sourceRef="Gateway_Additional_Questions" targetRef="Ask_Additional_Questions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Inspection results indicate additional questions are required</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_No_Additional_Questions" name="No additional questions" sourceRef="Gateway_Additional_Questions" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Additional_Questions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ask_Additional_Enter" sourceRef="Ask_Additional_Questions" targetRef="Enter_Additional_Values"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enter_Additional_Merge" sourceRef="Enter_Additional_Values" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Additional_Questions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_End" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge_Additional_Questions" targetRef="End_Inspection"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says that required information must be entered before a process phase can begin: Model the information-entry activities before the activities of that phase and connect them to the main flow with sequence flows.
rules.situation: the description says that required information must be entered before a process phase can begin

rules.instruction: When the description states the meaning of an activity, event, or gateway: label that BPMN element to preserve its stated meaning rather than substituting a generic or inferred alternative
rules.situation: the description states an action or decision in general terms without specifying a particular object or criterion

rules.instruction: When the description identifies the inputs or actions after which a process can begin: Model the stated prerequisites and begin the subsequent work after them; do not insert earlier setup activities or prerequisite flows unless the description supports them.
rules.situation: the description identifies the inputs or actions after which a process can begin

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes activities or outcomes by their action, object, recipient, or stage: Use BPMN labels that preserve those stated distinctions rather than substituting a different action or outcome.
rules.situation: the description states an activity, decision, or outcome at a particular level of specificity

rules.instruction: When the description says that an evaluation determines whether a follow-up activity is performed or omitted: Model the choice with an exclusive gateway and conditional paths for performing or skipping the follow-up activity; rejoin the paths before a subsequent activity only when the description states that one follows both outcomes.
rules.situation: the description says that an evaluation determines whether a follow-up activity is performed or omitted
